title: Mack Granite FUPS compliant polished custom Bullbar #20
description: Mack Granite hi-tensile custom built aluminium FUPS Bullbar. High tensile aluminium contoured main channel. High tensile 88mm diameter heavy duty 6mm wall pipe (optional 100 dia pipe available on request). Heavy duty tow pin and steel backing plate. Indicator repeater light mounted in main bar. Driving light or light bar mounts fitted to customer requirements. Optional bug mesh on request.
